name: Blinded
source: SRD 5.1 Conditions: Blinded (sight-based checks auto-fail: adjudicated by the DM)

name: Charmed
source: SRD 5.1 Conditions: Charmed (cannot attack the charmer; social advantage for the charmer is DM-adjudicated)

name: Deafened
source: SRD 5.1 Conditions: Deafened (hearing-based checks auto-fail: adjudicated by the DM)

name: Exhaustion
source: SRD 5.1 Conditions: Exhaustion level 1 only (disadvantage on ability checks); a long rest removes it

name: Frightened
source: SRD 5.1 Conditions: Frightened (source assumed in sight)

name: Grappled
source: SRD 5.1 Conditions: Grappled

name: Incapacitated
source: SRD 5.1 Conditions: Incapacitated

name: Invisible
source: SRD 5.1 Conditions: Invisible

name: Paralyzed
source: SRD 5.1 Conditions: Paralyzed

name: Petrified
source: SRD 5.1 Conditions: Petrified

name: Poisoned
source: SRD 5.1 Conditions: Poisoned

name: Prone
source: SRD 5.1 Conditions: Prone (melee = attacker in the same zone)

name: Restrained
source: SRD 5.1 Conditions: Restrained

name: Stunned
source: SRD 5.1 Conditions: Stunned

name: Unconscious
source: SRD 5.1 Conditions: Unconscious (no separate prone instance, see RULES_DECISIONS)

name: Dodging
source: SRD 5.1 Actions in Combat: Dodge (until the start of the creature's next turn)

name: Hidden
source: SRD 5.1 Unseen Attackers and Targets (set by the Hide action)

name: Surprised
source: SRD 5.1 Surprise (BG3: no movement, actions or reactions until the end of the first turn)

name: Helped
source: SRD 5.1 Actions in Combat: Help (advantage on the next attack or check, until the helper's next turn)

name: Blessed
source: SRD 5.1 Bless (add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws)

name: Shield of Faith
source: SRD 5.1 Shield of Faith (+2 AC)

name: Chilled
source: SRD 5.1 Ray of Frost (speed reduced by 10 ft, modelled as two thirds speed until the end of the caster's next turn)

name: Shocked
source: SRD 5.1 Shocking Grasp (cannot take reactions until the end of the caster's next turn)

name: True Strike
source: SRD 5.1 True Strike (advantage on the first attack roll of the caster's next turn; target-specific part not tracked)

name: Guided
source: SRD 5.1 Guiding Bolt (attacks against the target have advantage until the end of the caster's next turn; the SRD limits it to the next attack)

name: Mage Armor
source: SRD 5.1 Mage Armor (AC 13 + DEX for an unarmored target, modelled as +3 AC)

name: Blurred
source: SRD 5.1 Blur (attack rolls against the bearer have disadvantage)

name: Invisibility
source: SRD 5.1 Invisibility (as invisible; ends when the bearer attacks, modelled as the first attack roll)

name: Slowed
source: SRD 5.1 Slow (half speed, -2 AC, no reactions; the DEX save penalty and one-action limit are not modelled)

name: Nauseated
source: SRD 5.1 Stinking Cloud (a failed save spends the turn retching: no actions or reactions this turn)

name: Guidance
source: SRD 5.1 Guidance (BG3: +1d4 to every ability check while it lasts, not only one)

name: Resistance
source: SRD 5.1 Resistance (BG3: +1d4 to every saving throw while it lasts, not only one)

name: Bane
source: SRD 5.1 Bane (a d4 subtracted from attack rolls and saving throws)

name: Longstrider
source: SRD 5.1 Longstrider (speed +10 feet)

name: Barkskin
source: SRD 5.1 Barkskin (AC can't be less than 16)

name: Poison Ward
source: SRD 5.1 Protection from Poison (resistance to poison damage; the advantage on saves against being poisoned is not modelled)

name: Hunter's Mark
source: SRD 5.1 Hunter's Mark (the caster's weapon hits on the bearer deal an extra 1d6 of the weapon's type)

name: Expeditious Retreat
source: SRD 5.1 Expeditious Retreat (Dash as a bonus action on each turn)

name: Asleep
source: SRD 5.1 Sleep (unconscious until the spell ends or the sleeper takes damage; waking by an action is DM adjudicated)

name: Silenced
source: SRD 5.1 Silence (deafened, immune to thunder damage, no spells with a verbal component)

name: Turned
source: SRD 5.1 Channel Divinity: Turn Undead (must flee, no reactions, only the Dash action; modelled as unable to act or react, frightened, ends when it takes damage)

name: Burning
source: SRD 5.1 Alchemist's Fire (1d4 fire at the start of each of its turns until a creature uses an action to make a DC 10 Dexterity check to put it out; capped at 1 minute = 10 rounds, so it ends with the fight)
